desc:
Welcome to Build a Mini Golf ! ⛳

Create, customize and play your own mini golf course!
- Use code "RELEASE" for a small reward :D

🏗️ Buy Blocks & Build
- Get the craziest blocks and build the most fun course

💰 Play to Earn
- Play through your course to collect earned money

📈 Upgrade Your Course
- Upgrade to unlock new blocks, increase your multiplier and expand your build limit

⛳ Your course generates money while you’re offline!
